citations.desc: Environment enhancement to promote psychological well-being.
citations.narrative:
The licensee has an environment enhancement plan for birds, but the rheas and golden pheasants are absent from this
plan. Not having all species of birds on the environment enhancement plan doesn't ensure the psychological well-being
and health of the animals. The facility must ensure that a documented plan for environmental enhancement that
addresses the required elements including social grouping, environmental enrichment, special considerations, and
exemptions for the rheas and golden pheasants is approved by the attending veterinarian as well as maintained and
available for inspection. Correct by 11/22/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
Additional Inspectors:
Autumn Glencamp, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
